# Red-flag Research

> Red-flag Research is a research project from OpenLAIR that screens conference submissions for automated-research attacks, starting with paper laundering in ICLR 2027. Paper laundering means rewriting earlier public work into a submission that looks new, without credit. A "Source review recommended" label is a lead for a person to check, not a finding of misconduct.

Red-flag Research is by Ziqian Zhang at OpenLAIR (Lehigh AI Research Lab). Its first application screens all 43,013 ICLR 2027 submissions in public, in nine stages of up to 5,000 papers, from October 16, 2026, aiming to finish before ICLR 2027 decisions on December 16, 2026. The benchmark, evaluation tools and saved baseline outputs are public on GitHub and Hugging Face. Corrections: red.flag.autoresearch@gmail.com.

## Project

- [Homepage](https://red-flag-research.org/): what the project is, the nine-stage schedule, label meanings, how to get a result corrected
- [Feedback form](https://red-flag-research.org/feedback.html): report a wrong result, a bug or a benchmark problem by e-mail
- [How a paper gets a red flag](https://red-flag-research.org/blog/overview/): Red-flag notes, Part 0: what paper laundering is, what each label means, and the five steps from submission to a request for human review (read, extract, find sources, compare, label)
- [Finding the source](https://red-flag-research.org/blog/retrieval-v2/): Red-flag notes, Part 1: the rebuilt source-retrieval step, a full-text search over 2.92M arXiv papers plus a small source selector; Hit@3 0.910 on the public PAN200 benchmark, against 0.745 for the first live version
- [Live screening](https://red-flag-research.org/live/): coming soon: the per-submission screening view (extracted claims, candidate sources, side-by-side passages, label) is not public yet
- [Benchmark on GitHub](https://github.com/OpenLAIR/red-flag-research): 20 anonymized ICLR 2027 cases, 34 target–source pairs, human labels, evaluation tools and saved baseline outputs
- [Benchmark on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/red-flag-research/iclr2027-source-review-benchmark): the same benchmark as a dataset (CC BY 4.0)

## Labels

- Source review recommended: close matches to an earlier public paper without clear attribution; a person should compare the two
- No source finding: nothing found in the sources checked; this does not clear the paper
- Inconclusive: not enough evidence either way
- Same paper (preprint): the closest match is the paper's own earlier preprint
